verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's own Hub API docs say it provides webhooks to receive real-time incremental info about repos, which is a first-party outbound event subscription. The evidence is a single sentence, so the subscription mechanics and event coverage are unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of how to register a webhook endpoint (UI/API), the list of event types, payload format, secret/signature verification and retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: We also provide [webhooks](./webhooks) to receive real-time incremental info about repos.
